root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', 'TermsAccepted') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl ADD TermsAccepted BIT NULL, TermsText NVARCHAR(1000) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', 'HandedOver') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl ADD HandedOver NVARCHAR(2000) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl', 'PodSentAt') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileDeliveryProofTbl ADD PodSentAt DATETIME NULL, PodSentTo NVARCHAR(200) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH('dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl', 'DeliveryTerms') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.MobileApiSettingsTbl ADD DeliveryTerms NVARCHAR(1000) NULL, TermsUrl NVARCHAR(300) NULL; END
